name: Conversion Funnel
note: Six months of per-segment daily counts roll up into the funnel, KPIs and trend, so every total is the sum of its parts; bars morph between ranges with a linear() spring, the chart flips to horizontal rows under 540px, and the detail panel prices the weakest segment's drop-off. KPI tiles align on subgrid; set --dba-funnel-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Retention Cohorts
note: Rows are ARIA grid rows laid on a subgrid, so headers, sticky cohort labels and cells share one column template; cells colour themselves with color-mix(in oklch) from a single --p, sweep in on a diagonal --i stagger, and hovering one syncs a crosshair and preview line into the hand-drawn curve chart. Set --dba-cohort-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Acquisition Channels

name: Story Performance
note: Each story is modelled as a sequence of blocks (paragraphs, subheads, photos, a pull quote) with its own reader drop-off, drawn twice: as a page miniature inked by how many readers reached each block and as a depth curve aligned to it, with a shared crosshair. Rows rise in via animation-timeline: view() inside the list's own scroller (guarded by @supports); set --dba-content-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Experiment Readout
note: Real two-proportion z-tests on simulated daily traffic: drag the cumulative-lift chart or the range input to re-run the analysis through any day and watch the sampling curves tighten, the forest plot's intervals shrink and the verdict re-stamp. name: Journey Sankey
note: Sessions are generated as whole paths and rounded with largest remainders, so every node equals the sum of its links and tracing a step or a path highlights exactly the people who took it; the Sankey layout, link stacking and gradient ribbons are computed by hand and pour in column by column. Marching-ants overlays pause off screen; set --dba-journey-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Mobile App Health
note: Ninety days of per-platform, per-version sessions and crashes drive three views (a 100% stacked adoption chart with staged-rollout curves, a crash-free SLO chart showing a halted Android release and its hotfix, and engagement), and the top-crash list is allocated from the same crash totals so it sums to the KPI. Gauges sweep on an @property number and the release card swaps with a view transition; set --dba-mobile-h to 100dvh in an app.
